# Little Stars Play School

> Play group, Pre KG, kindergarten and day care, where children learn through play, stories and hands-on science.

Website: https://littlestarsplayschools.com/
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 72002 28559

## Contact
- Little Stars Play School · 20, 1st Cross St, Gangai Nagar, Velachery, Chennai 600 042 · +91 72002 28559 · littlestarsvelachery@gmail.com

## Key facts
- opened in Gangai Nagar 2022
- 5 programmes, from play group to day care
- 4 after-school activities

## Facilities
- Play Group (1½–2½ yrs)
- Pre KG (2½–3½ yrs)
- LKG & UKG
- Day care (above 1½ yrs)
- Montessori Method
- STEM learning
- Phonics
- Library time
- Water & sand play
- Field trips
- Puppet shows & skits
- Karate & yoga
- Bharatanatyam
- Violin
- Drawing & handwriting

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Little Stars Play School?
20, 1st Cross St, Gangai Nagar, Velachery, Chennai 600 042.

### What facilities does Little Stars Play School have?
Play Group (1½–2½ yrs), Pre KG (2½–3½ yrs), LKG & UKG, Day care (above 1½ yrs), Montessori Method, STEM learning, Phonics, Library time, Water & sand play, Field trips, Puppet shows & skits, Karate & yoga, Bharatanatyam, Violin, Drawing & handwriting.

### What ages do you take?
Play group from 1½ years, Pre KG from 2½, LKG and UKG from 3½ to 5½ years. Day care is open to children above 1½ years.

### Are there after-school activities?
Yes: karate and yoga, Bharatanatyam, violin, and drawing and handwriting.

### How do I visit Little Stars Play School?
Pick a date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 72002 28559.
